title: Business identity, KYB evidence and authorized representative verification
workflow: Identify registered organization and applicable legal-entity jurisdiction
Collect formation/registry evidence and required business documents
Validate status and authorized representatives through accepted sources
Construct ownership/control graph and flag unknown controlling parties
Screen relevant signatories and controllers under approved AML policy
Authorize KYB only when applicable evidence and independent review are satisfied
invariants: Registry evidence and business license are distinct proofs
Representative authority must be effective-dated and action-scoped
Unknown beneficial ownership must be treated as unresolved, not zero risk
Business status must be tied to a source observation date and registry authority
No unverified business may be silently promoted into credit/payment privileges
Preserve versioned KYB evidence for subsequent changes in directors/control
acceptance_tests: Representatives with expired mandates cannot submit corporate payment permissions
Missing required beneficial ownership evidence blocks normal approval
Change of controlling shareholder triggers review without rewriting old evidence
gate: Applicable KYB obligations, legally approved documentary matrix, registry and control-verification procedures.
